guide.overview: A **Guardian Champion built to counter spiritual damage**, Beast Boy uses **animal transformations** and **defensive buffs** to protect his squad. At the start of battle, he boosts the Spiritual Defense of [Teen Titans] and [Outsiders] allies.

legacyPieces.name: Teen Titans Utility Belt
legacyPieces.reason: Increases Beast Boy's Spiritual Defense. At the start of battle, his Spiritual Defense is further increased for a short time, and he immediately transforms into a T-Rex and lets out a roar, reducing all enemies' Attack and spiritual damage dealt. [Teen Titans] and [Outsiders] allies also gain extra Energy.

legacyPieces.name: Amazonium Alloy Shield
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts Physical and Spiritual Defenses and grants Beast Boy a shield when he's attacked, helping him hold the frontline.

legacyPieces.name: Improved Fear Gas Vial
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts HP, Spiritual Defense, and Dodge, helping Beast Boy maintain his defensive buffs.

legacyPieces.name: Razor Rib Umbrella
legacyPieces.reason: Boosts HP and Attack, balancing durability with damage in Beast Boy's animal forms.
